cases.public_task_description: Back-to-back bookings that meet exactly at a boundary are rejected even though their occupied time does not overlap. Correct this behavior while preserving business-hour validation, true overlap rejection, booking identifiers, ordering, and the existing public API.

Notification submissions may be retried with the same request key. The service currently sends an additional outbound message instead of reusing the original receipt, and conflicting reuse of a request key is accepted. Correct these behaviors while preserving validation, recipient history, receipt values, and the existing public API.

Invoices without discounts are calculated correctly, but percentage-discounted invoices charge tax using the undiscounted merchandise amount. Correct the discounted tax calculation while preserving monetary rounding, validation, persistence, audit and notification behavior, and the existing public API.
